_comment: Auth call sites deliberately NOT bounded. Everything else (.from/.rpc) is bounded centrally by installRequestTimeouts() in src/lib/supabase.ts. To add an entry you must state WHY racing it is unsafe — that requirement is the point of this file.

entries.reason: Auth operation. withTimeout is Promise.race and abandons rather than cancels, so racing it can leave a second concurrent auth op running and trip Supabase's refresh-token reuse detection, which REVOKES the session (docs/AUTH_AND_WEB_DEPLOY.md). A stall here spins a visible button the user can retry, not a full-screen skeleton.

httpClient's own auth-header path, which already applies its own explicit AUTH_HEADER_TIMEOUT_MS / AUTH_HEADER_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS bounds and single-flight refresh. Bounding it again here would double-race the refresh.

AuthProvider's init path. Already bounded explicitly via AUTH_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS with a documented safety argument (neither call refreshes nor retries, and onAuthStateChange repopulates unconditionally). Listed so the gate does not double-count it.
